model.family: multioutput linear-kernel Ridge on training-centered drug-specific DSS residuals
model.inner_cv: deterministic 5-fold patient split within each outer-training set
model.inner_selection_objective: patient-balanced mean squared error across the complete 24-drug residual profile
model.selection_tie_break: minimum MSE, then smaller k, then larger alpha

random_control.construction: one outcome-blind 32-column orthonormal basis per seed; each outer fold uses the first k_star columns

inference.simultaneous_method: paired patient-profile bootstrap maximum studentized deviation

claim_boundary: Operational finite-sample held-patient prediction; PCA is a deterministic function of full RNA and does not create information.
